note: GFP recreation area on the south-east shore of Lake Poinsett north of Arlington. Campground 1 runs for about a kilometre along the shore, its front row of sites on open grass above a narrow beach; Campground 2 sits in the trees to the east. Swim beach, boat ramp and fish-cleaning station. --Claude
